rationale: The pain is real and technically specific — Salesforce ISV DevOps teams genuinely hit this friction during every CI/CD pipeline run that gates on managed package release state. However, the market is extremely narrow (few hundred teams globally doing 2GP CI/CD), the single forum signal does not meet the minimum 5 distinct pain quotes threshold, there is no willingness-to-pay evidence found in public sources, and Salesforce's own tooling roadmap could close the gap. Evidence count falls well below the pass bar.
